User.title: User Profile
User.description: User account registration and synchronization metadata

userId.description: Unique identifier of the authenticated user matching their Firebase Auth UID

email.description: Primary email address of the user

emailVerified.description: Whether the user email is verified

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile activity

Transaction.title: Shop Transaction
Transaction.description: An income or expense transaction voucher

title.description: Title or description of the transaction

book.description: Name of the book the transaction belongs to

isIncome.description: True if income, false if expense

date.description: ISO timestamp for when the transaction took place

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this transaction

Book.title: Ledger Book
Book.description: A ledger book container to organize transactions

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this custom book

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Sub-collection of ledger transactions for a user

/users/{userId}/books/{bookId}.description: Sub-collection of custom defined ledger books for a user
